name: copilot-hub
description: A curated hub for sharing GitHub Copilot instructions, agents, prompts, and CLI plugins — your team's Copilot marketplace.

plugins.name: angular-development
plugins.description: Angular 21 full-stack development plugin. Covers standalone components, NgRx Signal Store, Angular libraries, PrimeNG, ESLint/Prettier setup, sakai-ui conventions, and testing with Vitest.

plugins.name: copilot-workspace
plugins.description: Setup and sync GitHub Copilot configuration from GravionLabs/copilot-hub. Provides an interactive wizard (gh-copilot-setup) to bootstrap .github/ with instructions, prompts, and agents tailored to your stack, plus a sync prompt (gh-copilot-sync) to keep them up to date. Includes gh-agents-md to scaffold an AGENTS.md repository context file. Issue workflow skills (gh-issue-implement, gh-issue-finish, gh-issue-work) automate the full branch → implement → review → PR lifecycle. The standalone scripts (copilot-sync.ps1, New-AgentsMd.ps1) are included for manual or scheduled runs without the AI prompt.

plugins.name: csharp-development
plugins.description: C#/.NET full-stack development plugin. Covers project setup, NUnit testing, async/await, code review, XML documentation, design patterns, EF Core, ASP.NET APIs, OpenAPI, MCP servers, .NET upgrades, modernization, Playwright .NET testing, and containerization.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Cross-cutting DevOps tooling. Publish code reviews as PR comments to GitHub or Azure DevOps, configure the az CLI azure-devops extension for pipeline integration, and create GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows using GravionLabs/ci reusable workflows.

plugins.name: go-development
plugins.description: Go development plugin for idiomatic Go applications. Covers module structure, error handling, interface design, concurrency patterns, table-driven testing, code review, and containerization.

plugins.name: helm-development
plugins.description: Helm chart development plugin for Kubernetes packaging. Covers chart structure, values.yaml design, named templates, security contexts, OCI distribution, Helmfile, and chart upgrades.

plugins.name: python-development
plugins.description: Python development plugin. Covers project setup with uv, pytest testing with fixtures and markers, type hints, code review, Playwright Python testing, and containerization.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security and resilience tooling. STRIDE threat modeling, security compliance review. Tech-stack agnostic – usable alongside any language plugin.

plugins.name: terraform-development
plugins.description: Terraform infrastructure-as-code development plugin. Covers module design, naming conventions, state management, security best practices, code review, and multi-cloud provider configurations.

plugins.name: typescript-node-development
plugins.description: TypeScript and Node.js development plugin. Covers strict typing, ESM modules, async/await patterns, error handling, code review, Playwright TypeScript testing, and containerization.
